title: CASB & Cloud App Control with Netskope
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (inline + API CASB across sanctioned/unsanctioned cloud apps; visibility, controls, DLP-adjacent policy, live-traffic risk).
Netskope console internals are deferred to Netskope's official documentation (no fabricated menus); authored at the correct architectural/procedural level.
hook: See and control every cloud app your people use — sanctioned or not
problem: Your people use hundreds of cloud apps, most of which IT never approved, and corporate data flows into them unseen. This solution delivers CASB and cloud app control with Netskope — discover sanctioned and shadow-IT cloud apps, score their risk, and apply inline and API-based controls (allow, restrict, coach, block, and data-movement policy) so cloud usage is visible and governed without blocking the business.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how Netskope CASB works (inline and API), cloud app discovery and risk scoring, the control levers (allow/restrict/coach/block, activity and data controls), and the govern-without-blocking approach.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Netskope tenant + CASB, steering/SWG in place, Entra ID identity, API connections to sanctioned apps, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: discover and risk-score cloud apps, define sanctioned/unsanctioned policy, apply inline activity controls and API controls for sanctioned apps, validate, then pilot, validate, and expand.
5 PowerShell scripts — cloud-app discovery readiness, control-policy validation, a cloud-app usage and risk report, safe remediation of policy gaps, and a CASB-scope group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Deliver CASB and cloud app control with Netskope — discover sanctioned and shadow-IT cloud apps, score risk, and apply inline and API controls so cloud usage is visible and governed without blocking the business. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
